capabilities: Browse and insert bundled adversaries, environments and items into notes or canvases
Build encounters with the battle calculator
Create and edit custom adversaries, environments and items
Create, embed and share player character sheets
Roll dice and review roll history
extras: Bundles Daggerheart SRD content under the Darrington Press Community Gaming License; installation is manual (download release files into .obsidian/plugins) and Obsidian 1.8.10+ is required; cards are stored as code blocks in notes and custom data lives in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to access Daggerheart game content, run battles or manage character sheets during play.

relations.evidence: A toolkit for Daggerheart, the TTRPG, inside Obsidian.

summary: Daggerheart TTRPG toolkit that inserts adversary, environment, item and character cards into notes, builds encounters, tracks characters and rolls dice.
